div.div: 3 فاركهُ , (AZ, O, K, TA,) inf. n. مُفَارَكَةٌ, (TA,) i. q. تَارَكَهُ [i. e. He left, forsook, or abandoned, him; or he did so being left &c. by him]; (AZ, O, K, TA;) namely, his companion; (AZ, O;) said by IF to be formed by substitution [of ف for ت]: (O, TA:) expl. in the A as meaning فَارَقَهُ [which is syn. with تاركه]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
